description: Polyphonic Moog-style low-pass ladder filter with two inputs mixed into it, an internal oscillator, and a resonance that reaches self-oscillation

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency of the filter; the numbered lamps report each polyphonic channel's cutoff as a colour, red at the low end and violet at the high one
Sets the resonance of the filter; turned high enough, the filter self-oscillates
Cycles the internal oscillator through off, triangle, sawtooth and square; while it runs, its wave takes the place of the input 1 signal going into the filter
Sets the level of the signal at input 1, clipping it at high settings; while the internal oscillator runs it sets that oscillator's frequency instead
Sets the level of the signal at input 2, clipping it at high settings

inputs.text: Scales the FREQ / LVL 1 knob, 5V giving the knob's own setting; while the internal oscillator runs it sets that oscillator's pitch, one volt per octave. With nothing patched it reads 5V
Scales the LVL 2 knob, 5V giving the knob's own setting; with nothing patched it reads 5V
Shifts the cutoff frequency through its attenuverter, 5V covering the whole FREQ knob range
Shifts the resonance through its attenuverter, 5V covering the whole RESO knob range
The signal for module channel 1; while the internal oscillator runs it phase-modulates that oscillator instead of feeding the filter

outputs.text: The two module channels summed and passed through the filter, ±5V
The two module channels summed before the filter, ±5V, or the bare internal oscillator while that runs

notes: the module is polyphonic: the channel count comes from whichever of the two audio inputs carries more, and every channel runs its own filter.
the two module channels are not the polyphonic channels: each polyphonic channel has a channel 1 and a channel 2 of its own, fed by the two audio inputs or by the internal oscillator.
the two level jacks read 5V when nothing is patched, so each level knob works on its own.
bypassing the module passes input 1 straight to the 1 + 2 output.

inputs.0:
0 to 5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 5V, or 2V for the oscillator pitch; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 5V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
